name: Nuclear risk
summary: No US–Russia arms-control limits; Iran lifts its missile range cap and warns on nuclear doctrine
state: New START has lapsed with no replacement (Arms Control Association). A Revolutionary Guards spokesman said on 7 Nov that Iran had lifted its self-imposed 2,000 km missile range limit and would respond if its leaders changed nuclear doctrine (RFE/RL). North Korea fired several missiles on 4 Nov. No nuclear test or change in alert levels had been reported as of 8 Nov.
for_you: No public-safety guidance has changed. Official advice on radiation emergencies is published by national emergency agencies.
rubric_hit: Arms-control lapse without replacement; doctrine threats = Watch

sources.title: Arms Control Association — North Korea and South Korea launch missiles amid tensions
RFE/RL — Iran live blog: US forces disable ship seeking to break blockade

why: Nuclear use anywhere would be a civilisational shock; arms-control treaties are weaker than at any time since the 1960s.
drivers: Threats in active wars, testing, doctrine changes, arms-control collapse, proliferation.

rubric.alert: A nuclear test, changes in deployment/alert levels, or threatened use in an active conflict.
rubric.watch: Explicit threats, unusual exercises, doctrine changes, or arms-control lapses without replacement.
rubric.normal: No explicit nuclear threats or tests; arms-control dialogue active.
